meta.display_name: American Physical Society journals (Physical Review family)
meta.status_detail: Mechanically migrated 2026-09-18 from the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal in docs_intel.py (round 2, proposal 64266f13, dated 2026-09-11) as part of the JSON-preset externalization work (proposal 3b93b7ef) -- values and evidence carried over verbatim from the real in-code comment, not regenerated.

source.note: most Physical Review journals prefer superscript numbered citations (Physical Review Letters and a few others use inline bracketed numerals instead -- callers targeting PRL specifically should override citation_style to 'numbered_bracket').

source.quote: make scans with as high a resolution as possible, preferably 600 dpi or higher
source.note: the guide's own explicit number (600 dpi) is stated specifically for SCANNED images, not as a blanket floor for every figure-creation method -- used here as figure_dpi_minimum_general with that caveat, since no separate non-scanned floor was stated.
